pages.text: Bung took a huge chopstickful of noodles. Slurp—gulp! No chewing, another slurp! The tied boat floated still. Beside Bung, little Ddori chewed slowly.
"I will eat quickly, then count passing boats with Ddori!" Mom served another bowl. Bung's cheeks bulged to bursting.
"Hic! Hic! Hic!" A tight throat stopped the noodles going down. Bung's face reddened. Ddori tapped Bung's back.
Mom stroked the back and offered water. "Breathe, then swallow slowly." Bung drank with both hands. The hiccups stopped. "You swallowed without chewing."
Mom lifted just a few noodles. "Only this much at once. Then ten good chews." She counted on her fingers.
Bung took a small bite and chewed. "One, two, three... eight, nine, ten!" The broth's flavor spread with each chew.
"Noodles are this sweet?" Another bite, more chews. Ddori copied beside Bung. "Do not gulp. Chew!"
Bowl empty, no hiccups! Bung's tummy felt comfortable. Bung drew Ddori's hand close, and they sat side by side at the boat edge.
With every chopstickful, Bung counted silently. "One, only this much! Two, ten chews! Three, then swallow!" One, two, three passing boats—Bung counted on fingers for Ddori.
Mom rubbed her cheek against Bung's head. Chewing made noodles much sweeter. Bung raised the chopsticks. "Do not gulp. Chew!"
